let WindowHours = 1h;
let BaselineDays = 90d;
let UserIpBaseline = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated between (ago(BaselineDays) .. ago(Lookback))
    | where ResultType == "0"
    | summarize by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress;
let RedirectFailures = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where ResultType == "50011"
    | project FailTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, FailIP = IPAddress, AppDisplayName;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where ResultType == "0"
| join kind=leftanti UserIpBaseline on UserPrincipalName, IPAddress
| join kind=inner RedirectFailures on UserPrincipalName
| where TimeGenerated between (FailTime .. FailTime + WindowHours)
| project SuccessTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, NewIP = IPAddress, Location, AppDisplayName, FailTime, FailIP, DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, FailTime)
| order by SuccessTime desc
2588.spl:

| join type=inner user [
    | tstats summariesonly=true count as fail_count values(Authentication.src) as fail_src from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=failure Authentication.signature_id=50011 by Authentication.user

| sort - firstTime

| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("unbcl.dll") or FolderPath has_any ("C:\Windows\debug\NetSetup.log"))

DeviceFileEvents

| where (FolderPath has_any ("C:\Windows\debug\NetSetup.log") or FileName in~ ("unbcl.dll"))

description: Kerberos AS-REQ for a machine account using certificate pre-authentication, the authentication step of CVE-2026-54121 Certighost.
references:
  - https://thehackernews.com/2026/07/certighost-exploit-lets-low-privileged.html
  - https://gist.github.com/H0j3n/a5ef2609b5f2944ac2390a191a534c26
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/27
tags:
  - attack.t1649
  - attack.t1550.003
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4768
    TargetUserName|endswith: '$'
  cert:
    CertSerialNumber|exists: true
  filter_empty:
    CertSerialNumber: '-'
  condition: selection and cert and not filter_empty
level: high

| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`

    | where Timestamp > ago(Window)
    | where EmailDirection == "Inbound"
    | where Subject startswith "TASK"
    | project InTime = Timestamp, Victim = RecipientEmailAddress, AttackerAddr = SenderFromAddress, AttackerDomain = SenderFromDomain;
EmailEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Window)
| where EmailDirection == "Outbound"
| extend RecipientDomain = tostring(split(RecipientEmailAddress, "@")[1])
| project OutTime = Timestamp, Victim = SenderFromAddress, ReplyTo = RecipientEmailAddress, RecipientDomain
| join kind=inner TaskInbound on Victim
| where RecipientDomain =~ AttackerDomain
| where OutTime between (InTime .. InTime + 1h)
| project InTime, OutTime, DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', OutTime, InTime), Victim, AttackerAddr, ReplyTo, AttackerDomain

2746.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Hacker Runs Hermes AI Agent Unattended for Post-Exploitation at Thai Finance Min
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("linpeas.sh", "hive_rce_py2.py", "hivecmd.jar"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine

DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("linpeas.sh", "hive_rce_py2.py", "hivecmd.jar"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
